column1: # What the desktop expects, per package manager. Same format as
#   group  tool  gentoo  apt  dnf  pacman  zypper  brew
# tool is a command, font:<family> or file:<path>. - means no package there.
# No brew column in use: this desktop is Linux only.
# The login screen (greeter/install.sh). Installed with the rest, but only that script enables it.
# Gentoo only. quickshell's ebuild compiles it; everywhere else build-quickshell.sh
# does. LibreWolf elsewhere comes from flatpak with ./install.sh --apps (apps.txt).
# Mullvad's daemon and CLI from its official RPM, without the app (portage/overlay).
# Other distros get Mullvad from mullvad.net's repository.
